notes: Performance Schema is off, so per-table and per-file I/O cannot be read. MariaDB ships with it off. To turn it on, add performance_schema=ON under [mysqld] in my.cnf and restart the server (it cannot be changed at runtime). It then uses some memory and a little CPU. Or turn on user statistics with SET GLOBAL userstat = ON (runtime, small overhead on every statement) for rows read and changed per table.
